messages:
Asha: Quick sync — product wants to keep server-side prefetch in scope for the Q3 pilot, but runtime flagged ~30% tail-latency risk unless we change batching. Need tradeoffs + clear owners.
Miguel: Can we narrow scope to 'client-side prefetch only' vs 'server-side KV prefetch'? Server-side needs runtime kernel work.
Riley: Runtime: server-side prefetch increases mem pressure + KV cache miss amplification at long sequences. Mitigations: eager eviction + shard-size tweaks, but infra must provision extra memory.
Samira: Infra: capacity wise we need a reserved slot and prewarm automation. Budget shows 2 free reserved slots for Q3; pushing one out would need sponsor.
Jon: Security: server-side prefetch touches customer prefixes. We need prefix isolation, minimal KMS surface, and updated audit logs. Private customers may require masking.
Asha: Proposed path: keep server-side prefetch as opt-in experimental behind a feature flag (`prefetch.server_opt_in`), default to client prefetch. Product OK with that for pilot? :thinking_face:
Priya: Eng mgmt: need explicit SLOs and an automatic rollback plan. If 95th percentile latency exceeds the SLO, auto-fallback to non-prefetch flow.
Miguel: I'll draft rollout + metrics (latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, cost delta). Who owns feature flag toggles and infra changes? @Samira?
Samira: Infra will own capacity and prewarm automation; runtime owns kernel/eviction changes. We need a 2-week dev window and one staged reserved capacity increase.
Riley: Also: confirm quantized model behavior with prefix caching. Small generation regressions possible — will run a quick eval against golden prompts.
Jon: Security checklist: threat model, data-flow diagram, KMS key review, and audit-log plan. I can do a threat model if PM provides a simple flow diagram by EOD Wed.
Asha: Action items (agree if correct):
- Miguel: rollout plan + metrics dashboard (due Thu)
- Riley: kernel mitigation plan + perf budget (due Mon)
- Samira: capacity commit + prewarm runbook (due Tue)
- Jon: threat model + KMS review (due Wed)
Miguel: noted, will include dashboard mocks and a canary gating plan.
Riley: noted, will include microbenchmark numbers and expected tail risk.
Samira: ack — I'll check reserved slot procurement and update costs.
Jon: ack, will block time Wed afternoon.
deploy-bot: Reminder: new feature flags require infra approval in #eng-infra and a short RFC link. See <https://redwood.internal/flags> for the checklist.
Asha: Thanks — unless new blockers surface, I'll lock scope to 'opt-in server prefetch behind `prefetch.server_opt_in`' for pilot and proceed to schedule the pilot kickoff. :white_check_mark:
